name: Nexora Product Insights for WooCommerce
author: Amin

sections.description:
Nexora Product Insights for WooCommerce helps store owners understand how individual products perform — without relying on external analytics tools.

The plugin tracks real customer interactions and displays clear, actionable insights directly inside WooCommerce, where store owners actually work.

What you can measure

  • Product page views
  • Add-to-cart actions
  • View-to-cart conversion rate per product

All data is aggregated, privacy-friendly, and optimized for performance.

Key Features

  • Product View Tracking
    Counts valid product views using session-based tracking.

  • Add to Cart Tracking
    Tracks add-to-cart actions for simple and variable products.

  • Conversion Rate Calculation
    Automatically calculates view-to-cart conversion rates.

  • WooCommerce Admin Integration
    Displays conversion data in the Products list table and inside the product edit screen.

  • Lightweight & Fast
    Uses a dedicated database table with minimal queries — suitable for large catalogs.

  • Privacy Friendly
    No personal data, cookies, or third-party services involved.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/nexora-product-insights-for-woocommerce/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Products → All Products to see the new conversion column.
  4. Edit any product to view detailed performance insights.
